name: WordPress
description: The official WordPress image with a MySQL database, its files on a lasting volume and an HTTPS address. Signs in at /wp-admin with the admin user and the password shown to the team's owners and admins in the console.

env.WORDPRESS_CONFIG_EXTRA: define('WP_HOME', getenv('APP_URL')); define('WP_SITEURL', getenv('APP_URL')); if (PHP_SAPI !== 'cli' && preg_match('#/wp-admin/(install|setup-config)[.]php#', (string) filter_input(INPUT_SERVER, 'SCRIPT_FILENAME'))) { http_response_code(404); exit; }

setup.command: p=$(cat); wp core is-installed 2>/dev/null && exit 0; wp core install --url="$APP_URL" --title="$CP_APP_NAME" --admin_user=admin --admin_email="$CP_ADMIN_EMAIL" --admin_password="$p" --skip-email
